Multiple real/recovered teaching surfaces exist, but there is no single current authoritative teacher page/root: project-alumnos remains unbound in PROJECT_INDEX even though Continuity Head records its discovery return as consumed into a binding candidate. José Study, Student World, PageKit/Class Player and the future coordination root remain distinct authorities.

non_obvious_findings: The important missing object is not a page but a binding: existing child pages can be reopened, yet the durable Alumnos selector still has no root owner after discovery produced a concrete binding candidate.

The label alumnos-teacher is currently a coordination surface identifier, not proof of one physical page/product. Treating it as a page would erase distinct ownership boundaries across José Study, Student World and Class Player/PageKit.
The current José Study source already consumes the canonical Study v1 owner, so future root/page composition should reuse that owner rather than create another shared teaching UI implementation.
